items.title: 2.6.1.1 Creating, Accessing, and Modifying Lists (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of creating lists (PDF 50-51).

blocks.text: List square brackets [ ] ke andar items likh kar banti hai, aur har item ke beech comma hota hai. List mein alag alag type ki cheezein ho sakti hain: numbers, strings, balke doosri lists bhi.
Misaal: apne pasandeeda phalon (fruits) ki list banayein.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab "Apple" aur "Banana" ke beech comma nahi chhapti. Aise Python dono strings ko jor deti hai aur output ['Mango', 'AppleBanana'] aata hai (sirf do items). Comma ke saath teen items aate hain, jaise oopar.
Wazahat: yeh code fruits naam ki list banata hai jis mein teen items hain, aur phir list print karta hai.

blocks.prompt: Agar "Apple" aur "Banana" ke beech comma chhoot jaye, jaise kitab ke chhape code mein, to kya hoga?
blocks.explanation: Python saath likhi do strings jor deti hai, to list mein do cheezein hongi, 'Mango' aur 'AppleBanana'.

items: List: [item1, item2, ...]; items ke beech comma zaroori.
